briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push frontier as DialectForge secures multi-agent protocols

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race accelerates with major model releases from US and Chinese labs driving record funding. Compute constraints and safety gaps remain central bottlenecks. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation emerges as a protocol-level defense amid rising injection threats.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with advanced reasoning while xAI releases Grok-4. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4 variants close capability gaps. Anthropic's Claude 4 emphasizes constitutional AI updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell clusters to Microsoft and Google while TSMC ramps 2nm production. New Middle East data centers target 500MW AI loads amid power shortages.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level defenses like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier multi-agent deployments by 2027?
